title: Location History Timeline
description: The on-device Google Maps Timeline export (`Timeline.json` / `location-history.json`), introduced in 2024 when Location History moved from the server to the device. Replaces the old per-month Semantic Location History files. Top level holds processed semantic segments, raw device signals, and an aggregated user location profile.

semanticSegments.title: Semantic Segments
semanticSegments.description: Processed, chronologically ordered segments of the user's timeline. Each segment carries a start/end time plus exactly one of `timelinePath`, `visit`, `activity` or `timelineMemory`.

rawSignals.title: Raw Signals
rawSignals.description: Unprocessed device signals (positions, detected activity records and Wi-Fi scans) the timeline was derived from.

geoString.title: Geo Coordinate String
geoString.description: A latitude/longitude pair formatted as a single string with degree symbols, e.g. `"49.7403348°, 6.650313°"` (latitude first, then longitude).

latLng.title: Lat/Lng Wrapper
latLng.description: Object wrapping a single coordinate string under the `latLng` key.

isoTimestamp.title: ISO 8601 Timestamp
isoTimestamp.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone offset, e.g. `2024-11-22T10:53:29.000+01:00`.

semanticSegment.title: Semantic Segment
semanticSegment.description: A single timeline segment. Always has `startTime`/`endTime`; the payload is one of `timelinePath`, `visit`, `activity` or `timelineMemory`.

startTimeTimezoneUtcOffsetMinutes.description: UTC offset of `startTime`, in minutes. Absent on raw `timelinePath`-only segments.

timelinePath.title: Timeline Path
timelinePath.description: Ordered list of recorded points forming the path travelled during the segment.

visit.title: Visit
visit.description: A stay at a fixed place for a duration of time.

hierarchyLevel.description: Nesting depth of the visit (0 = top level).

probability.description: Probability that this segment is a visit, in the range 0 to 1.

isTimelessVisit.description: True when the visit has no reliable duration.

placeId.description: Google Maps Place ID of the candidate place.

semanticType.title: Visit Semantic Type
semanticType.description: Semantic classification of the place relative to the user.

probability.description: Probability that this candidate is the correct place, in the range 0 to 1.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: A journey from one place to another (walk, drive, transit ride, flight, ...).

distanceMeters.description: Distance travelled during the activity, in meters.

probability.description: Probability that this segment is an activity, in the range 0 to 1.

type.title: Activity Type
type.description: Detected activity/travel-mode type. Open enum; known values include UNKNOWN_ACTIVITY_TYPE, WALKING, RUNNING, CYCLING, HIKING, SKATING, IN_VEHICLE, IN_PASSENGER_VEHICLE, IN_BUS, IN_TRAIN, IN_SUBWAY, IN_TRAM, IN_FERRY, IN_CABLECAR, FLYING, CATCHING_POKEMON.

probability.description: Probability that this activity type is correct, in the range 0 to 1.

timelineMemory.title: Timeline Memory
timelineMemory.description: An aggregated 'memory' such as a trip spanning multiple destinations.

distanceFromOriginKms.description: Maximum distance of the trip from its origin, in kilometers.

placeId.description: Google Maps Place ID of the destination.

rawSignal.title: Raw Signal
rawSignal.description: A single raw device signal. Exactly one of `position`, `activityRecord` or `wifiScan` is present.

position.title: Position
position.description: A raw location fix. Note the capitalised `LatLng` key (unlike the lower-case `latLng` used elsewhere).

accuracyMeters.description: Approximate accuracy radius of the fix, in meters. Lower is better.

source.title: Position Source
source.description: Origin of the location fix. Open enum; known values include UNKNOWN, WIFI_ONLY, GPS, CELL.

speedMetersPerSecond.description: Instantaneous speed in meters per second, when available.

activityRecord.title: Activity Record
activityRecord.description: A raw on-device activity-recognition reading with candidate activities.

type.title: Probable Activity Type
type.description: Low-level activity-recognition type. Open enum; known values include UNKNOWN, STILL, WALKING, RUNNING, ON_FOOT, ON_BICYCLE, IN_VEHICLE, IN_ROAD_VEHICLE, IN_RAIL_VEHICLE, EXITING_VEHICLE, TILTING.

confidence.description: Confidence of this activity type, in the range 0 to 1.

wifiScan.title: Wi-Fi Scan
wifiScan.description: A raw Wi-Fi scan with the access points seen at delivery time.

mac.description: MAC address of the access point, encoded as an integer.

rawRssi.description: Raw received signal strength indicator, in dBm.

userLocationProfile.title: User Location Profile
userLocationProfile.description: Aggregated profile derived from the user's history: frequent places, frequent trips and travel persona.

placeId.description: Google Maps Place ID of the frequent place.

waypointIds.description: Ordered Google Maps Place IDs of the waypoints along the trip.

startTimeMinutes.description: Typical start time, in minutes past midnight (local).

endTimeMinutes.description: Typical end time, in minutes past midnight (local).

confidence.description: Confidence in this frequent trip, in the range 0 to 1.

mode.description: Travel mode (open enum, e.g. WALKING, IN_BUS, IN_TRAIN, IN_SUBWAY, IN_PASSENGER_VEHICLE, RUNNING).

rate.description: Share of trips taken with this mode, in the range 0 to 1.

persona.title: Persona
persona.description: Aggregated travel-mode affinities of the user.

mode.description: Travel mode (open enum, e.g. WALKING, IN_BUS, IN_PASSENGER_VEHICLE, IN_TRAIN, FLYING, CYCLING, RUNNING).

affinity.description: Relative affinity for this mode, in the range 0 to 1.
